answer: No voyage leaves the shop without its maker's mark, and the mark is earned, not printed. Proof of cutler blade via cutlers company is the rule here: a blade the cutlers company passes only after the cutler grinds an edge he actually honed. The nebula proves the hand that held the tool; the ledge proves the hour it was held. To fake both, a cheat must hire 19 hands and 19 hours he never spent, and each fake still fails the third test — the grain of the work itself.
